name: Injury Table
notes: Any character that became a casualty in the battle must roll on the Injury Table (Bot and Soulless characters use the Bot Injury Table instead). If a character was merely knocked out (from suffering 3 Stun results simultaneously), no roll is required. If a character with Luck would be slain through a roll on this table, they miraculously survive, but immediately lose ALL Luck points. Damaged equipment cannot be used until it has been Repaired (p.78).

rows.detail: Dead, and all carried equipment is damaged.
Dead, or removed from the campaign.
The character survives and receives +1 Luck, but all items carried are permanently lost.
Require 1D6 credits of surgery immediately, or suffer -1 permanent reduction to highest of Speed or Toughness.
